open_items: ILO has been failing continuously for 4 consecutive cycles (1342-1345, 8 hours), escalating gateway_issue -> gateway_issue -> provider_down -> degraded, longer and worse than every prior occurrence of the catalogued Cloudflare/WAF 403 pattern (which previously self-cleared within 1-3 cycles). Live recheck at cycle 1345 confirmed direct path still 403 with Cloudflare headers, same signature as the known pattern. Watch closely; if still failing next cycle, this is materially different from the historical flakiness and worth raising beyond this routine.

ECB gateway_issue at cycle 1345 (chronic empty 'Error: ' bug, same shape as cycles 1337 and 1339), direct path confirmed healthy by live recheck. Expect self-heal next cycle based on history; not fixed by this routine.

STATSNZ auth:listing capability_appeared, first seen cycle 60, still present at cycle 1345 (no change in this cycle's /api/contracts changes, which is empty). Still open, not re-reported since no new change.
claude/ triage branches on origin: 159 as of this run (unchanged from cycle 1342's 160), still well above the 20 the skill flags for pruning; not actioned by this read-only routine.

Monitor bug noted previously and reconfirmed this run: /api/history computes status without contracts, so a contract-only degraded state never shows up in /api/history, only in /api/status and /api/contracts.

Chronic gateway bug (empty 'Error: ' message from tools/sdmx_tools.py around lines 207-209 catching Exception with an empty str(e)): previously traced on ABS (many occurrences), ESTAT (cycle 1143, 1335), and ECB (cycle 1337, healed by 1338; recurred cycle 1345). Not fixed by this routine; it only commits to docs/monitor/.

Long-running architectural facts, not incidents: ILO /availableconstraint/ returns 500 (constraints come via ?references=all); ECB does not support /availableconstraint/ (404 is expected, not an error); ESTAT has no practical constraint support; ESTAT direct json check is skipped by design (Eurostat returns 406 for SDMx-JSON); IMF direct json check is skipped by design (IMF ignores the JSON Accept header and returns XML); STATSNZ direct json check is skipped by design (Stats NZ ignores the JSON Accept header and returns CSV); BIS/ILO/IMF references:contentconstraint reads ignored (accepted and silently dropped); encoding:structure_xml Content-Type charset/version parameter order flips cosmetically from time to time across ABS/FBOS/ILO/SBS/OECD, verdict stays ok as always; ILO gateway path has a recurring Cloudflare/WAF 403 flakiness pattern that usually self-clears within one to a few cycles and implicates no gateway code (though the current occurrence has run longer than any prior one).
